2.en: The novel introduces readers to a universe of strange creatures.
2.zh: 这部小说把读者带入一个充满奇异生物的宇宙。

5.en: The nurses formed a union to ask for safer working conditions.
5.zh: 护士们组成了工会，要求改善工作安全条件。

6.en: The city is home to a diverse mix of people and languages.
6.zh: 这座城市汇聚了来自不同背景的人，也有多种语言。

7.en: Please convert the photo to a smaller file before you send it.
7.zh: 请先把照片转换成较小的文件再发送。

8.en: Turn the key in reverse to open the lock.
8.zh: 把钥匙反方向转动来开锁。

11.en: The new rule caused controversy among parents and teachers.
11.zh: 这项新规定在家长和老师中引起了争议。

13.en: In contrast to the old phone, this one has a much brighter screen.
13.zh: 与旧手机相比，这款手机的屏幕亮得多。

22.en: The job involves answering customer emails.
22.zh: 这份工作包括回复客户邮件。

25.en: The road is closed because of ongoing repairs.
25.zh: 道路因维修仍在进行而封闭。

29.en: A little sunlight can enhance the color of this room.
29.zh: 一点阳光就能让这个房间的颜色更加鲜明。

36.en: We checked the roof after the storm to make sure it was watertight.
36.zh: 暴风雨过后，我们检查屋顶，确保它不漏水。

42.en: The formation of ice made the path too slippery to use.
42.zh: 结冰使这条小路变得太滑，无法通行。

45.en: All visitors must conform to the safety rules in the lab.
45.zh: 所有访客都必须遵守实验室的安全规定。

46.en: Drivers must comply with the speed limit on this road.
46.zh: 司机必须遵守这条路的限速规定。

47.en: The team met to formulate a plan for the school trip.
47.zh: 小组开会制定学校出游计划。

53.en: The bank will notify you by text when your card is ready.
53.zh: 银行卡办好后，银行会发短信通知你。
